{{Quote|Can you stop being droid bait out there?! You're getting in my way!|Hevy during training|<ref name="cc" />}}
'''Droidbait''', whose [[Cloning|clone]] number was '''CT-00-2010''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who was part of the Domino Squad. While training as a [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]], he earned the nickname "Droidbait" for his tendency to be shot first during practice. After graduating with [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]], he was stationed on a remote [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon]], where he was killed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] as the station came [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|under attack]].

==Biography==
===Clone cadet on Kamino===
{{Quote|I'm gonna draw their fire. You guys blast them!|Droidbait to Domino Squad|<ref name="cc" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> CT-00-2010, who took on the chosen name of "Droidbait," was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> During training exercises with [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]] as a [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]], Droidbait would ultimately end up following [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], despite the warnings of [[Echo/Legends|Echo]]. During the squad's final exam, he was shot and split his shoulder. [[Cutup/Legends|CT-4040]] was the only one to stop and help him, and the squad failed for leaving a man behind.<ref name="cc" />

Once he was put in the medical bay on a gurney, the [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]] tended to his wound. As he did so, Droidbait said he felt like it was his fault his team failed, and that he felt like he was always acting as "droid bait." El-Les said that it was not his fault, and that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] would let him and the rest of his squad redo the final exam the next day.<ref name="defenders">''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]''</ref>

Droidbait and his fellow squad members passed the cadet final exam on the next try by succeeding without their ascension cables. Droidbait played a key role by drawing turret fire away from his squad.<ref name="cc" />

===Service on the Rishi moon===
{{Quote|You two. Go find him.|O'Niner, ordering Nub and Droidbait to find trooper CT-327|audio=ONiner-You2.flac|<ref name="defenders" />}}
[[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]] shipped out a day later and was stationed on a remote [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon]] that warned [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] of any attacks. Under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]], Droidbait and the other rookie troopers monitored nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and were tasked with warning the Republic of any [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] attacks. Unbeknownst to the clone troopers, the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to attack [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="rookies" />

Knowing that the clones at Rishi Station would detect the attack, Grievous deployed several [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] to [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|capture]] the Rishi listening post. Inside the station, O'Niner lost contact with deck [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]], who was patrolling outside the listening post. Unaware that the commando [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had [[Death/Legends|killed]] CT-327, O'Niner ordered Droidbait and [[Nub/Legends|Nub]] to find the missing trooper. However, after the two clones opened the listening post's [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] entrance the commando droids revealed themselves and attacked Droidbait and Nub, killing them.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> The commando droids gained control of the facility, although the surviving members of Domino Squad retook the base with the help of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].<ref name="rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Droidbait" first appeared in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the Clone Wars TV series]]. He also appeared in the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], titled "[[Clone Cadets]]," which chronologically took place before "Rookies." In the episodes, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices most of the clone troopers through the series.<ref name="EpGuide" />

Droidbait received the clone designation number "CT-00-2010" in the accompanying episode guide for "[[Clone Cadets]]" on StarWars.com, which was published in September [[2010]]. However, Droidbait later received the designation "CT-28-631" in the short novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]'', released on [[October 7]], 2010.

The code "DROIDBAIT" can be acquired at the end of the game "Clone sharpshooter" on [[StarWars.com]] if the player reaches a certain high score. If the player then enters the code in the game "LiveFire," which can also be played on starwars.com, the player becomes a commander, upgrading their blaster shot and grenade toss accuracy from 15 out of 100% to 80 out of 100%. The player will also be followed by four clone troopers in the game, who help the player but die much more easily.
